operators.name: cat_forward
semantics: Concatenates tensors x and y along dimension dim (dim=1) in the same order as torch.cat((x, y), dim=1)
Input tensors are on CUDA, contiguous, float32
Output is a new tensor with shape [16, 12, 1024, 1024] where the first 8 channels are from x and the next 4 channels are from y
No broadcasting; dimensions other than dim must match

operators.name: multiply_scalar_forward
semantics: Multiplies every element of input by the scalar value (self.input_size, which is int 16 but passed as float)
Output tensor has same shape, dtype, device as input
No broadcasting beyond scalar; elementwise operation
Concatenate x (shape [16,8,1024,1024]) and y (shape [16,4,1024,1024]) along channel dimension (dim=1)
Result shape [16,12,1024,1024], dtype float32, device cuda:0, stride [12582912,1048576,1024,1]
Output order: x channels first, then y channels
Multiply each element of the concatenated tensor by scalar self.input_size (16)
Result shape [16,12,1024,1024], dtype float32, device cuda:0, stride [12582912,1048576,1024,1]
Return the final tensor after scalar multiplication
